summary: Chart Industries filed an 8-K reporting that Baker Hughes filed a Form CO with the European Commission on May 21, 2026, initiating Phase I review for their pending acquisition. Under the July 2025 Merger Agreement, Chart will be acquired by Baker Hughes via a merger of Merger Sub into Chart, with Chart surviving as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. The filing does not disclose financial terms or advisor names. The Phase I review timeline suggests closing expected in July 2026, subject to EC and other regulatory approvals. Watch for Phase I clearance or a Phase II referral; risk-arb focuses on regulatory timeline and any conditions imposed.
